text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. Automation now handles repetitive tasks, so workers can focus on more interesting projects. Productivity tools powered by AI help employees manage their time, organise documents, and make faster decisions. Human-AI collaboration is also becoming common, as people work alongside smart systems to solve problems together. However, these changes affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones will appear, and workers will need to learn new skills. Overall, AI offers great opportunities, but it also requires people to adapt and keep learning throughout their careers.
